key_idea: Check both rules for each boat: more than 1 circle, and 2 more triangles than squares.
steps: Boat A has only 1 circle, so it is out.
Boat C has 2 circles, 4 triangles and 2 squares.
4 is 2 more than 2, so boat C follows both rules.

choice_feedback.B: Boat B has 2 triangles and 1 square. That is only 1 more triangle.
choice_feedback.D: Boat D has 3 triangles and 3 squares. That is not 2 more.
choice_feedback.E: Boat E has 5 triangles and 2 squares. That is 3 more, not 2.
